sources.limitations: Perspective render, landscaping partially conceals base; dimensions are not survey measurements.
Perspective render useful for volume, planted buffer and surrounding streets; no dimensions.
Marketing plan with numbered amenity legend; diagram has no dimensional scale.
Dusk render useful for entry composition and main facade; tree occlusion and perspective.

hard_expected_shapes: elongated slab tower with approximately 3.5:1 roof footprint aspect ratio
substantial planted buffer at opposite end to gate

reference_validation.method: Side-by-side images from cameras matched to reference perspectives, plus separate top-plan comparison. Rendered marketing references do not justify dimensionally exact reconstruction.
must_check: 5 balcony stacks arranged 2+1+2 on the main long face
tower footprint width/length and height proportions
pool and entry at opposite ends of street-side amenity strip
forest occupying far end of site
stepped roof and tall central shaft
reference_validation.qualitative_gate: All hard expected counts and layout relationships must match. Any guessed dimensions, back-face details or unseen geometry must be marked as inferred.
reference_validation.silhouette_metrics: Use only after perspective alignment and architectural masks; do not compare full scenes with different landscape/background by raw SSIM or IoU.
